config: one B70, no speculation, FULL_DECODE_ONLY capture sizes 1-64, strict launcher env, max-model-len 1024, one slot; three independent campaigns (q1, q2, q3), two fresh servers each
verdict: Three independent fresh-server pairs scored 11/12, 9/12 and 11/12 on the strict 12-prompt completions suite (15 pairwise comparisons range 9/12 to 12/12, mean 10.3). Exactly three of the twelve prompts are tie-prone and each has exactly two variants; the other nine are identical across all six servers. Servers pick between the two variants independently, so this is a tie in the next-token scores resolved by per-process state, not drift or a broken gate. The base identity gate cannot pass on this route, so no lossless claim and no package is made from it. The 9B showed that this class of flip disappears on the row-invariant W4A16 INT4 kernel; the 4B W4A16 route is measured next.
